# Internal preparation phase contract: P1-P8 within the CP-0 handoff.
# No standalone module identity, run anchor or CP-PARSE artifact is emitted.
properties
  document_parse_manifest type object
    required pipeline workspace_record input_sources triage parse_jobs
      prepared_artifacts representation_catalog package_record verification
    properties
      pipeline type object
        required run_id objective preparation_status
        properties
          run_id type string
          objective type string
          preparation_status enum READY READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS BLOCKED
      workspace_record type object
        required run_workspace source_roots originals_immutable derivatives_isolated
        properties
          run_workspace type string
          source_roots type array minItems 1 items type string
          originals_immutable type boolean const true
          derivatives_isolated type boolean const true
      input_sources type array minItems 1 items type object
        required original_source_id logical_source_id original_file_name original_sha256
          document_family authority_quality accessibility
        properties
          original_source_id type string
          logical_source_id type string
          original_file_name type string
          original_sha256 type string pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
          document_family type string
          authority_quality type string
          accessibility enum ACCESSIBLE DEGRADED BLOCKED
          entity_ids type array items type string
          reporting_periods type array items type string
          version_status type string
          related_base_source_id type string null
      triage type array minItems 1 items type object
        required logical_source_id decision score rationale extraction_profile frozen
        properties
          logical_source_id type string
          decision enum PARSE_FULL PARSE_TARGETED PASS_THROUGH SKIP_DUPLICATE SKIP_LOW_VALUE BLOCKED
          score type integer minimum -4 maximum 11
          rationale type string
          extraction_profile type array items enum LAYOUT_TEXT TABLE_FIRST SLIDE_CHART LEGAL_CLAUSE OCR_SCAN SHEET_RANGE HYBRID
          selected_replacement_source_id type string null
          frozen type boolean const true
      parse_jobs type array items type object
        required parse_job_id logical_source_id methods status extraction_confidence coverage_status
        properties
          parse_job_id type string
          logical_source_id type string
          methods type array minItems 1 items type string
          status enum COMPLETE DEGRADED BLOCKED
          extraction_confidence enum HIGH MEDIUM LOW FAILED
          coverage_status enum COMPLETE DEGRADED BLOCKED
          limitation_flags type array items type string
      prepared_artifacts type array items type object
        required artifact_id logical_source_id file_name path sha256 artifact_kind
        properties
          artifact_id type string
          logical_source_id type string
          file_name type string
          path type string
          sha256 type string pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
          artifact_kind enum PREPARED_MARKDOWN SUPPORTING_IMAGE SUPPORTING_TABLE PACKAGE_INDEX TRIAGE_REGISTER REPRESENTATION_CATALOG CHECKSUMS
      representation_catalog type array minItems 1 items type object
        required logical_source_id original_source_id triage_decision representation_kind
          content_role readiness_input selection_basis limitation_flags
        properties
          logical_source_id type string
          original_source_id type string
          triage_decision type string
          selected_artifact_id type string null
          representation_kind enum ORIGINAL PARSED NONE
          content_role enum ACTIVE_CONTENT PROVENANCE_AND_VERIFICATION_ONLY INVENTORY_ONLY EXCLUDED
          readiness_input enum ORIGINAL PARSED NONE
          selection_basis type string
          limitation_flags type array items type string
      package_record type object
        required packages safe_paths checksums_valid batch_reconciled
        properties
          packages type array items type string
          safe_paths type boolean const true
          checksums_valid type boolean const true
          batch_reconciled type boolean const true
      verification type object
        required inventory_complete originals_immutable representation_unique
          locator_coverage package_validation canonical_markdown
        properties
          inventory_complete enum PASS FAIL
          originals_immutable enum PASS FAIL
          representation_unique enum PASS FAIL
          locator_coverage enum PASS FAIL NA
          package_validation enum PASS FAIL NA
          canonical_markdown enum PASS FAIL
